description: Payments applied against invoices, credit notes, prepayments and overpayments in the connected Xero organisation. Reads are page-paginated (page / pageSize with the sibling pagination envelope) and support incremental sync on UpdatedDateUTC via the If-Modified-Since REQUEST HEADER. Write covers CREATE ONLY. Xero exposes PUT Payments (createPayments) and the collection-level POST Payments (createPayment, 'creates a single payment for invoice or credit notes') — both are CREATEs. Unlike the other writable Xero collection resources there is no update-or-create: Xero documents NO update operation for an existing payment, and the item-level POST Payments/{PaymentID} is deletePayment (body PaymentDelete {Status: DELETED}), i.e. delete/reverse. So no upsert mode is authored; PaymentID is the server-generated record identity, not a documented upsert-match key. Payments does not accept the unitdp query param.

pageSize.description: Records per page; owned by pagination. Xero documents a default of 100 and states no maximum for this resource, so no pagination `max` is declared.

If-Modified-Since.description: Xero returns only records created or modified at/after this timestamp. Wire format: 2020-02-06T12:17:43.202-08:00. Owned by replication (cursor UpdatedDateUTC). getPayments $refs the ifModifiedSince parameter in the Xero OpenAPI spec, which is authoritative here even though the generated xero-ruby doc omits it.

schema.title: Xero GET Payments response
schema.description: Xero wraps records in the standard response envelope alongside Id/Status/ProviderName/DateTimeUTC metadata and, on page-paginated resources, a sibling pagination object; the Payments array carries the records.

Id.description: Response envelope: request correlation id assigned by Xero.

Status.description: Response envelope: call status, 'OK' on success. Not the per-payment Status field.

ProviderName.description: Response envelope: the name of the calling Xero app.

DateTimeUTC.description: Response envelope: server timestamp in Xero MS-JSON form, e.g. /Date(1550797359081)/.

pagination.description: Page-number pagination envelope returned alongside the records.

Payments.description: The payment records for this page.

PaymentID.description: Xero identifier for the payment, e.g. 99ea7f6b-c513-4066-bc27-b7c65dcd76c2. The resource primary key — server-generated and read-only.

Date.description: Date the payment is applied, MS-JSON date-only envelope (e.g. /Date(1721347200000+0000)/); the Xero spec marks this field x-is-msdate: true. Calendar date — no time component. The Payment model has no DateString sibling.

BankAmount.description: Amount of the payment in the currency of the bank account it was made from/into. Monetary.

Amount.description: Amount of the payment in the currency of the document being paid. Monetary.

CurrencyRate.description: Exchange rate applied when the payment is in a currency other than the organisation's base currency (a ratio, e.g. 0.7500) — not money, so it stays Float64 rather than being rounded to 4dp.

PaymentType.description: What the payment was applied to; derived by Xero from the document being paid. Sample: ACCRECPAYMENT.

UpdatedDateUTC.description: Last-modified timestamp, Xero MS-JSON with an explicit offset, e.g. /Date(1541176592690+0000)/ — UTC-anchored per that sample. The replication cursor.

Reference.description: Optional free-text reference for the payment, e.g. ref/cheque.

IsReconciled.description: Whether the payment has been reconciled. The top-level value is a real JSON boolean (the copy nested inside BatchPayment is a JSON string).

Account.description: Bank account the payment was made from/into; surfaced opaque.

Invoice.description: Invoice the payment is applied to; surfaced opaque.

CreditNote.description: Credit note the payment is applied to; surfaced opaque.

Prepayment.description: Prepayment the payment is applied to; surfaced opaque.

Overpayment.description: Overpayment the payment is applied to; surfaced opaque.

InvoiceNumber.description: Number of the invoice this payment is applied to, e.g. INV-4003. A denormalised convenience field on the Payment record; the nested Invoice object is surfaced opaque, so this value is not otherwise recoverable. May be null on payments applied to a credit note, prepayment or overpayment.

CreditNoteNumber.description: Number of the credit note this payment is applied to. A denormalised convenience field on the Payment record; the nested CreditNote object is surfaced opaque, so this value is not otherwise recoverable. May be null on payments applied to an invoice, prepayment or overpayment.

BatchPayment.description: Batch payment this payment belongs to; surfaced opaque — Xero returns its nested numerics and booleans as JSON strings, so it must not be descended into.

HasAccount.description: Whether the payment has an associated account.

HasValidationErrors.description: Whether the payment carries validation errors.

BatchPaymentID.description: Xero identifier of the batch payment this payment belongs to, when part of a batch.

BankAccountNumber.description: The supplier's bank account number the payment is being made to.

Particulars.description: The supplier's bank account particulars carried with the payment.

Code.description: The supplier's bank account code carried with the payment.

Details.description: The information to appear on the supplier's bank statement for this payment.

StatusAttributeString.description: Validation status attribute returned on write responses (ERROR / WARNING).

schema.title: Xero Payment (PUT Payments request body)
schema.description: One Payment object. Xero's createPayments request body is a Payments array of Payment objects; this endpoint posts exactly one payment per request (a singleton envelope) so the documented Idempotency-Key header stays authorable — idempotency and batching are mutually exclusive, and no first-party Xero batch cap is grounded. Requiredness is not declared: the researched facts ground the Payment field set and its wire types, not the provider's per-field create requirements. This is a CREATE only — Xero documents no update operation for an existing payment.

PaymentID.description: Xero identifier for the payment. Server-assigned on create; carried by the Payment schema and returned in the write response. NOT an upsert-match key — Xero exposes no update operation for a payment.

Date.description: Date the payment is applied (calendar date, MS-JSON date-only envelope).

BankAmount.description: Amount of the payment in the currency of the bank account it is made from/into.

Amount.description: Amount of the payment in the currency of the document being paid.

CurrencyRate.description: Exchange rate to the organisation's base currency (a ratio) — not money.

PaymentType.description: What the payment is applied to; normally derived by Xero from the document being paid.

UpdatedDateUTC.description: Last-modified timestamp, Xero MS-JSON with explicit offset. Maintained by Xero.

Reference.description: Optional free-text reference for the payment.

IsReconciled.description: Whether the payment has been reconciled.

Account.description: Bank account the payment is made from/into (AccountID or Code); passed through opaque.

Invoice.description: Invoice being paid (InvoiceID or InvoiceNumber); passed through opaque.

CreditNote.description: Credit note being applied; passed through opaque.

Prepayment.description: Prepayment being applied; passed through opaque.

Overpayment.description: Overpayment being applied; passed through opaque.

BatchPayment.description: Batch payment the payment belongs to; passed through opaque. Xero returns its nested numerics and booleans as JSON strings.

HasAccount.description: Whether the payment has an associated account. Maintained by Xero.

HasValidationErrors.description: Whether the payment carries validation errors. Maintained by Xero.

BatchPaymentID.description: Xero identifier of the batch payment this payment belongs to.

BankAccountNumber.description: The supplier's bank account number the payment is being made to.

Particulars.description: The supplier's bank account particulars carried with the payment.

Code.description: The supplier's bank account code carried with the payment.

Details.description: The information to appear on the supplier's bank statement for this payment.

StatusAttributeString.description: Validation status attribute returned on the write response (ERROR / WARNING).
